answer: Control of a Discord account is proven with a hash-commitment reveal: the owner first publishes a hash of a secret, then reveals the secret to prove control, and the registry accepts the link only if the response verifies. A yarrow of the nonce is enough to bind the claim to this round, a jetty of reuse is caught by the nonce log, and a inlet of stale proofs is discarded, so each identity rests on a Discord account its agent truly controls.
